description: Implementation of the F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) reset procedure for DU (Distributed Unit) in 5G network, including message sending, transaction handling, and response processing.

classes.name: f1ap_du_initiated_reset_procedure
classes.description: Class managing the F1 reset procedure initiated by the DU, including message construction, transaction management, and response handling.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the reset procedure asynchronously, managing transaction creation, sending reset message, and awaiting response.

methods.name: send_f1_reset
methods.description: Constructs and sends an F1 reset message to the CU-CP, including UE reset list if provided.

methods.name: handle_f1_reset_completion
methods.description: Handles the completion of the reset transaction, checking for success or failure.
